scripts.contracts:types: npm run contracts:openapi && npx openapi-typescript openapi.json -o static/api-types.d.ts
scripts.contracts:check-generated: node scripts/run_py.js scripts/check_openapi.py && npx openapi-typescript openapi.json --check -o static/api-types.d.ts
scripts.check: npm run contracts:check-generated && node scripts/run_py.js -m unittest discover -s tests -v
